title: Lab Science
description: A laboratory science course in chemistry or physics (as part of a two-semester sequence) or a further science course in biology, chemistry, physics, or earth science.
notes: UConn: a two-semester chemistry or physics sequence plus one science course from another department (12 credits).

title: TOI Course
description: A general education course from the university's Common Curriculum, in an area such as creativity, cultural dimensions, governance, diversity, or the environment.
notes: UConn Common Curriculum Topics of Inquiry.

title: CSE 3150 or CSE 3160 (C++ Essentials)
description: A programming course that deepens skill in one language or paradigm, here either C++ (memory management, classes, templates, the standard library) or functional programming (higher-order functions, recursion, types).
notes: Choice slot: UConn's CSE 3150 or CSE 3160. Official descriptions are in data/raw/uconn/ (courses-cse page).

title: CSE Elective 3000+ or Concentration Course
description: An upper-level computer science course, either from a chosen concentration (such as algorithms and theory, cybersecurity, or data science) or any 3000+ level CSE course.
notes: UConn: a concentration (one required course plus nine credits) or 12 credits of 3000+ CSE electives.

title: CSE Elective
description: A computer science course chosen by the student to reach the required total of CSE credits.
notes: UConn: CSE courses as needed to reach 43 CSE credits.

title: Probability & Statistics Course
description: A calculus-based course in probability or statistics: random variables, distributions, expectation, and an introduction to statistical inference.
notes: Choice slot: UConn's MATH 3160 or STAT 3025Q, 3345Q, or 3375Q (STAT descriptions were not saved).

title: Free Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.
